About us
 
Aave Labs began with a simple question: how do we make financial services like borrowing, saving, and earning more accessible globally?
 
We built the Aave Protocol, now the world’s largest and most trusted onchain lending market, connecting decentralized finance with individuals, traditional finance, and fintech.
 
Today, we build trusted, high-quality products that expand access to lending, credit, and savings globally
 
Our culture
 
We build trusted products that help people access and discover economic opportunities.
 
We hold a high bar for quality and craftsmanship. No detail is too small. Trust depends on it.
 
We’re a global team building products people can actually use, turning complex technology into something simple and reliable.
 
We stay aligned, move quickly, and think long term, while keeping teams lean and focused on impact.
 
About the role

We’re looking for a Director of Operations to lead the operational function supporting our growing global business.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role responsible for building the processes, systems and operating infrastructure needed to deliver a seamless customer experience at scale. You’ll sit at the intersection of Product, Engineering, ICT &Security, Compliance, Support and the wider business, ensuring our day-to-day operations are efficient, resilient and ready to support continued growth.

The role combines Group-wide operational leadership with specific regulatory responsibilities within our Irish regulated entity, Push Virtual Assets Ireland Ltd. The successful candidate will be expected to obtain approval from the Central Bank of Ireland to perform the Pre-Approval Controlled Function of Chief Operating Officer (PCF-42) and undertake responsibilities associated with Controlled Function CF-8 (Complaints Adjudication).

You’ll be responsible for ensuring that our regulated operations meet applicable regulatory requirements, while developing proportionate and scalable operational frameworks for the wider business. This requires someone who understands how to balance operational efficiency, customer experience and innovation with the governance, accountability and controls expected of a regulated financial services business.

Given the nature of our products, you’ll help ensure we maintain a high bar for operational excellence while meeting the requirements expected of a regulated financial services business.

lists.text: How you can make an impact:
lists.content:
• Develop and scale the operational strategy, structure and processes required to support a growing global business and customer base without compromising quality, controls or customer experience
  • Assume responsibility for the operational management of Push Virtual Assets Ireland Ltd in the capacity of PCF-42, ensuring effective oversight of its day-to-day operations, operational risks, controls and regulatory obligations.
  • Identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies and operational risks, implementing processes and systems that improve reliability, speed and quality of execution
  • Ensure we deliver a consistently high-quality customer experience across key operational touchpoints, from onboarding through to ongoing support and issue resolution
  • Own the Group’s complaints management framework, ensuring complaints are appropriately identified, investigated, escalated and resolved, with specific responsibility for complaints adjudication within the Irish regulated entity in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to use tooling, automation and AI to reduce manual processes, improve efficiency and create better experiences for both customers and internal teams
  • Define and monitor operational KPIs, identifying trends, risks and opportunities and translating data into clear actions and priorities
  • Bring operational and customer insights into product development, helping identify friction points, improve customer journeys and ensure operational readiness for new products and launches
  • Own relationships and performance across relevant operational vendors and service providers, ensuring they meet our standards for quality, reliability and customer 
  • Partner closely with Compliance and Legal to ensure operational processes and customer outcomes meet applicable regulatory requirements
  • Work with ICT & Security to oversee operational resilience, incident management and business continuity arrangements, working closely with relevant teams to ensure operational risks and incidents are appropriately identified, managed, escalated and remediated.
  • Hire, coach and develop a high-performing Operations organisation with a strong culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Provide operational reporting and management information to executive leadership and relevant Boards, ensuring appropriate visibility of operational performance, customer outcomes, incidents, complaints and material risks.

• You have 8+ years of experience in Operations, Customer Operations, Business Operations or a related function, with meaningful experience in a senior leadership role
  • You’ve built or scaled operations within a high-growth consumer technology, fintech or financial services business
  • You have experience operating across regulated and unregulated business activities, with an understanding of how operational requirements, governance and controls differ depending on the nature of the business
  • You have experience delivering customer experiences at scale, with a strong understanding of how operations, technology and support come together across the customer journey
  • You have a track record of designing processes and operating models that can scale with significant customer and transaction growth
  • You understand how to use technology, automation and AI to improve operational efficiency and reduce unnecessary manual work
  • You’re highly data-driven and comfortable establishing KPIs, analysing performance and using data to prioritise improvements
  • You have experience working closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance and other cross-functional teams
  • You have a strong understanding of the operational and governance requirements applicable to regulated financial services businesses, including customer complaints, operational risk management and regulatory accountability.
  • You have experience being a PCF-42 or a similar regulated position
  • Experience within crypto or Web3 is strongly preferred, particularly within consumer-facing products, but isn’t essential

lists.text: How you can make an impact:
lists.content:
• Lead and build the Risk team, setting direction, priorities, and standards for the function
  • Own and evolve Aave’s risk management frameworks and policies
  • Set minimum review standards and provide independent challenge for product-specific risk frameworks
  • Establish model-risk and data-governance standards for material quantitative models and external risk inputs, including validation, versioning and monitoring
  • Review whether product and engineering controls adequately implement approved risk requirements, with explicit ownership of gaps, exceptions and incident response
  • Establish standards for external risk providers and data dependencies, including methodology, independence, conflicts, data quality, performance and fallback arrangements
  • Own the governance, approval thresholds and escalation process for protocol-risk parameters; oversee monitoring and review material change recommendations
  • Approve and sign off on collateral onboarding decisions and risk assessments
  • Review liquidation performance and recommend improvements to liquidation mechanisms
  • Lead risk governance processes and present risk analyses to the DAO
  • Monitor market structure changes and their implications for protocol risk
  • Take accountability for the quality, independence and timeliness of Risk’s assessments, ensuring residual risks, decision owners and escalation paths are explicit and drive a culture of ownership within the team

• 5+ years of experience in risk management, with a strong preference for DeFi or crypto-native experience
  • Proven experience leading and managing a risk team
  • Deep understanding of the Aave Protocol: its markets, governance, parameters, and risk dynamics
  • Strong grasp of market structure, portfolio risk management, and stress testing methodologies
  • Experience governing risk for composable DeFi products or pooled strategies, including external protocol, liquidity, oracle, counterparty, execution and operational dependencies
  • Experience working with or managing external risk service providers
  • Strong sense of accountability and ownership. You take responsibility for outcomes and hold your team to the same standard
  • Excellent judgment under uncertainty. You’re comfortable making consequential decisions with imperfect information
  • Strong communication skills for governance proposals, risk reports, and stakeholder alignment

• Previous experience working directly with DeFi governance processes
  • Background in traditional finance risk management (portfolio, credit, or market risk)
  • Familiarity with risk tooling and simulation platforms used in DeFi

lists.text: How you can make an impact:
lists.content:
• Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements, including strategic partnerships, technology and software agreements, integrations, vendor and service agreements
  • Partner closely with Business Development, Product and other teams to structure complex commercial arrangements and develop practical legal solutions that enable new partnerships and products
  • Support the negotiation and execution of strategic partnerships with financial institutions, fintechs, infrastructure providers and other participants across the digital asset ecosystem
  • Provide legal support throughout the lifecycle of partner integrations and strategic initiatives, from initial structuring and negotiation through implementation and launch
  • Advise teams across the business on contract interpretation, rights, obligations and commercial risk
  • Support acquisitions, asset purchases, acqui-hires and other strategic transactions from initial evaluation through signing and completion
  • Conduct and coordinate legal due diligence, identifying key risks and translating findings into clear, practical recommendations
  • Draft, review and negotiate transaction documentation, including NDAs, LOIs, term sheets, purchase agreements, IP transfer arrangements and other ancillary documents
  • Work closely with senior stakeholders and external counsel on transaction structuring, negotiation and execution
  • Advise on corporate, commercial and intellectual property considerations arising from strategic transactions
  • Support post-transaction matters, including the transfer and integration of contracts, intellectual property and other assets
  • Develop and improve commercial templates, contracting processes and legal playbooks to enable the business to move efficiently and at scale

• 4+ years of experience as a practising lawyer, with a strong background in corporate and commercial law and experience handling complex transactions
  • Experience working in fintech, crypto or digital assets, with a strong understanding of the commercial and legal environment
  • Strong experience drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements
  • Experience advising on acquisitions, corporate transactions and other complex commercial arrangements
  • Working knowledge of digital asset regulatory frameworks, including securities law issues and token classification, as they bear on deal structuring and diligence
  • Familiarity with DeFi protocols and on-chain/DAO governance structures, including where they arise as transaction counterparties or acquisition targets
  • Experience conducting legal due diligence and drafting and negotiating transaction documentation
  • Experience structuring transaction consideration involving tokens, as distinct from standard cash or equity consideration
  • Experience within a leading law firm and/or an in-house legal team within a technology or financial services environment
  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to identify material legal risks and translate them into practical recommendations
  • Ability to operate autonomously, manage multiple workstreams and take ownership of transactions from start to finish
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to work with senior internal and external stakeholders
  • Experience working across multiple jurisdictions and coordinating specialist external counsel where required
  • Preference is for this role to be based in New York, NY, and relocation assistance is available for the right candidate.

As an equal opportunities employer, we take accountability and believe in everyone's potential to build, create and inspire changes. With a mission to build a diverse workforce, we are proud to foster a working environment in which everyone can feel safe and valued for who they are.

lists.text: How you can make an impact:
lists.content:
• Own the technical direction and architecture for Push across backend services, external integrations, data flows, and onchain settlement
  • Translate product, regulatory, and operational requirements into a clear engineering roadmap, well-scoped projects, and sound technical decisions
  • Design and build resilient services for on-ramp and off-ramp transaction lifecycles, including payment initiation, status tracking, settlement, exception handling, and customer notifications
  • Lead integrations with open-banking, payments, identity, compliance, and blockchain infrastructure providers
  • Define secure boundaries between fiat systems, non-custodial wallets, and onchain execution, ensuring sensitive data, permissions, and signing-related flows are handled appropriately
  • Set and uphold standards for secure development, architecture review, testing, observability, incident response, deployment, and sustainable on-call ownership
  • Partner closely with Product, Compliance, Legal, Security, Operations, Finance, and application engineers
  • Remain hands-on in the codebase, particularly for complex architecture, high-risk changes, and critical production issues

• 8+ years of backend engineering experience, including senior technical leadership of production systems and teams
  • Experience designing distributed, event-driven systems that move or account for real money, with a strong understanding of failure modes and operational risk
  • Experience with regulated financial products and understanding how to balance compliance and regulatory requirements with product features and goals    
  • Strong backend programming skills. Production experience with Rust is highly desirable; deep experience with Go, Java, C++ can substitute
  • Strong knowledge of API design, PostgreSQL or another relational database, messaging systems, and service-to-service integration patterns
  • Experience in regulated fintech, payments, banking, digital assets, or another environment requiring auditability, controls, and high availability
  • Excellent system-design judgement, including migration strategy, build-versus-buy decisions, security boundaries, and the long-term operational cost of architecture choices
  • A track record of leading engineers through ambiguous, high-impact work while remaining close to implementation and production operations
